match.verdict: Consistent with a warm brown dwarf, type L0 to L2 (best match L1).

candidates.type: dust + star (dust 1000 K; star 8000 K, A_V 5)

match.method: Chi-square fits of the SPIFF brown-dwarf templates (Gagné et al., arXiv:2604.22012) and of non-brown-dwarf comparisons (reddened stars, dust, power laws, star plus dust), compared by an information criterion on rescaled chi-square, with a goodness-of-fit gate and a check that the template's molecular bands are actually seen.

pass_agreement.sentence: 1 of 4 passes typed on their own disagree with the combined result (spx-2026b: uncertain, L1).

warnings: Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010 (three-band), 2010-2011 (post-cryogenic), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
5 of 469 SPHEREx spectrum points are left out (3 where too much of the target is covered by bad pixels, 2 where the target saturates the detector).
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.

field_movers.sentence: We searched this patch for anything else that moved between 2010 and 2024. We found 1 star already known to move and nothing unexplained. The search also picked up the target itself without being told where it is.
